title: fix(app-shell,i18n,data-objectstack): the computed strip reason is worded, and the table and the batch-6 pin compile against both the pinned spec and objectstack main (objectui#11206)
body:
Fixes #11206

Clause-②: no

## What was red

The required `Spec Main Shape Gate` compiles objectui against `@objectstack/spec` built from objectstack `main`. objectstack `b2805465` (`fix(objectql)!: a caller-supplied formula value is stripped on every write path and reported as computed`) added a fourth arm, `computed`, to `DroppedFieldsEvent['reason']`. Two objectui sites were written to fail at exactly that moment, and did: the `STRIPPED_LINE` wording table in `writeWarningToast.ts` (keyed by the union, so the new arm is a missing key) and the batch-6 pin `_ReasonIsTheEnum` in `spec-symbol-batch6.test.ts` (which stated the union as exactly three arms). The upstream change is intended; objectui adapts, and the gate, its workflow and its required status are untouched.

## Both compiles, reproduced with the gate's own flow

objectstack `main` at `1741c5dcb62d` was fetched the way the workflow fetches it (blobless, depth 1, cone `packages/spec scripts patches`), `@objectstack/spec` was built and packed, and `node scripts/spec-main-shape-gate.mjs inject` put it into this worktree's install. The compile was `turbo run type-check --continue` narrowed to the closure of the three packages the card names (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, `@object-ui/console`: 38 tasks), and the verdict is the gate's own `report` step over that log.

| spec compiled against | tree | turbo | gate `report` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| built from objectstack `main` `1741c5dcb62d` | base `846cec0efe` | 34 of 38 ok (`TURBO_FORCE=true`, 0 cached); failed: app-shell build, app-shell type-check, console type-check, data-objectstack type-check | exit 1, "4 diagnostic(s) in 2 objectui file(s)" |
| built from objectstack `main` `1741c5dcb62d` | this branch `02282232a5` | 38 of 38 ok (7 builds replayed from the base run, recorded against the same injected spec) | exit 0, "objectui type-checks against `@objectstack/spec` at that commit" |
| published `@objectstack/spec@17.5.0` (injected copy removed and reinstalled: no gate marker, three-arm enum in the declarations) | this branch `02282232a5` | 38 of 38 ok (`TURBO_FORCE=true`, 0 cached), 0 `error TS` lines | not applicable (the pinned build is what every other CI job compiles) |

The gate's table on the base, cited by symbol rather than by line:

| objectui file | where | code | message |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `packages/data-objectstack/src/spec-symbol-batch6.test.ts` | `_ReasonIsTheEnum` | TS2344 | Type 'false' does not satisfy the constraint 'true'. |
| `packages/app-shell/src/providers/writeWarningToast.ts` | `STRIPPED_LINE`'s declaration | TS2741 | Property 'computed' is missing … but required in the Record keyed by the four-member union (three times: app-shell build, app-shell type-check, console type-check) |

After the change the same step prints no rows. objectstack `main` has moved since the card's reading (`93e9e4263c38`); the four diagnostics are identical at `1741c5dcb62d`.

## The spelling, and why not `satisfies`

The card pointed at the `satisfies` precedent (`UNDRAWABLE_VIEW_KINDS`, objectui#9880). Measured with this repository's TypeScript 6.0.3 on a scratch probe, it does not carry over: `satisfies` runs the same excess-property check on an object literal, so a `computed` row under `satisfies Record` OF the pinned union is TS2353 against 17.5.0, exactly like the bare annotation. The precedent works there because it is `satisfies Record` OF `string` and gets totality from a second, separate table; that shape would mean a second declaration here.

What this PR does instead: `STRIPPED_LINE` is keyed by `DroppedFieldsEvent['reason'] | 'computed'`. The required key set is then the same four on both sides (the pin's three plus the literal; `main`'s four, where the literal is already a member), so the one table compiles against both, and it still names the spec's union as the thing being covered: the same probe shows the NEXT arm upstream adds is a TS2741 missing key under this spelling, which is the property `STRIPPED_LINE`'s docblock promises.

The widening is a silent no-op once the pin carries `computed`, and no compiler reports a no-op. So a vitest tripwire, `reminds the pin bump that carries computed to retire the widening (objectui#11206)`, asserts the installed spec does not declare `computed` and names both things to do when it does (delete the `| 'computed'`, make `_ReasonIsTheEnum` the four-member union). Firing control: run against the main-built spec it fails with that message (1 failed, 29 passed across the two files); against 17.5.0 it passes.

## The pin

`_ReasonIsTheEnum` now asserts that the union minus `computed` equals `'readonly' | 'readonly_when' | 'primary_key'`. That stays exact on each side: `computed` is the only member the `Exclude` can absorb, so any other new arm is a remainder `Equal` refuses, and `_ReasonIsNotString` is unchanged. The comment names `b2805465` and says the assertion becomes the four-member union when the pin moves past 17.5.0.

## The wording

A new key, `detail.writeStrippedComputed`, in all ten packs under `packages/i18n/src/locales/`. English: "Calculated by the server from a formula, so the value sent did not take effect: FIELDS". It says the server computes the field and ignored the value sent, never "read-only", matching the pattern of the three sibling keys.

## Tests and gates (worktree root; exit codes captured before any pipe)

- Gate reproduction, main-built spec, base: turbo exit 2, gate `report` exit 1 (table above). On this branch: turbo exit 0, `report` exit 0.
- Pinned 17.5.0, this branch, forced: turbo exit 0 (38 of 38).
- `pnpm exec vitest run` on `writeWarningToast.test.ts`, `spec-symbol-batch6.test.ts` and `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` against 17.5.0: 3 files, 62 tests passed.
- The same two test files against the main-built spec: 29 passed, and the tripwire failed as designed (the firing control above).
- `tsc --listFilesOnly` confirms both test files are in the type-check programs (`app-shell`'s `tsconfig.test.json`, `data-objectstack`'s `tsconfig.json`).
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys` exit 0; `pnpm check:i18n-drift` exit 0 ("1 key(s) added"; no `en` value changed); `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys` exit 0, and the new key is not among its candidates; `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` exit 0; `pnpm check:control-bytes` exit 0; `pnpm check:new-line-citations` exit 0 ("0 new citation(s)").
- ESLint over the 13 changed `.ts` files: exit 0, 0 errors, 0 warnings (`--format json` counts). Type-aware linting is not enabled in `eslint.config.js`, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file; the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

Changeset: `.changeset/11206-computed-strip-wording.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

## Acceptance notes

- **When a user first sees the new sentence.** The adapter judges a reported `reason` against `RECOGNIZED_DROP_REASONS`, read off the installed spec's `DroppedFieldsEventSchema`. 17.5.0 does not declare `computed`, so a formula strip from a server running objectstack `main` is still routed to the skew arm (`UNRECOGNIZED_DROP_REASON`) and reads "Not applied by the server: FIELDS" — truthful, without the cause — until the pin carries the arm. The render test drives `emitWriteWarning` directly, which is where the table is reachable today. The changeset says this rather than promise the sentence now.
- **Narrowing.** The local compiles cover the closure of the three packages above, not the whole repository the gate compiles; the card's CI reading (whole repository, `--continue`) found only these two files, and this pull request's own gate run is the whole-repository reading.
- **Card premise.** Zone 2's first assumption held (the two sites were the whole population in the reproduced closure); its second did not carry over as stated (`satisfies`, above); its third and fourth were done as written.
